terra.problem: The passage does not say that the news was no surprise to heaven.
Luke 1:13 does not establish that Zechariah was a priest. That fact needs a supporting reference, such as Luke 1:5.
The claim that Elijah was a prophet in Israel is outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say what anyone in the temple courts saw or establish where Joseph slept.
The claim about angels appearing in fields is outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say Joseph lay down or that he did not go anywhere.
The angel tells Joseph to embrace Mary as his wife. The passage does not say the angel tells him to take her home.
Calling saving His people from their sins Jesus' whole mission goes beyond what the passage says.
The claim that Naomi was a widow is outside this passage and needs a reference.
“Wrong blank” uses “wrong” about the baker's answer, which Papa Dorin does not do.
The punchline makes the parentheses and the way Scripture is written part of the joke.
Papa says he cannot remember which other name has that meaning, conflicting with his knowledge of the whole Bible. The claim about another name also needs a reference.
The passage does not say nobody was sent anywhere or that Mary stayed by Joseph's side.
